PERCENT_SELL × SELL_MIN_SIGNAL1

52 symbols, 7×11 = 77 cells, 5.3 min. Everything else stays at its configured value; only the sell price threshold and the slope gate move, and neither touches the warmup — signal1 is loaded for every cell including the None column, so all 77 share one start index.
What this asks. The gate blocks a sell while momentum is still up, but the price clears its median threshold at the TOP of a move, which is exactly when the trailing slope is still positive. By the time the slope releases the gate, part of the peak it was protecting is gone. If that is right the two are not separable: a lower PERCENT_SELL should want a looser gate, because the lag then holds through more of the remaining move.
Polarity. The gate blocks when slope ≥ threshold, so a HIGHER threshold blocks FEWER bars. None removes the gate entirely, which is not the same as the top of the axis.
Read the interaction table before the heat map. The heat map's best cell looks good whether or not any effect exists — it is the best of 77. The question is whether the best slope CHANGES down the PERCENT_SELL rows. One repeated value means the two are separable and sweep_sell_signal1 already answered this at 75; a drift is the finding.
Live cell: PERCENT_SELL=50, SELL_MIN_SIGNAL1=0.228 — every paired figure on the heat map is against it. In the interaction table the gain is against each row's OWN live-slope cell instead, which is what holds the price threshold fixed so only the gate moves.

Skipped: MSB (only 406 bars after warmup), NAB (only 453 bars after warmup), OCB (only 381 bars after warmup), SSB (only 347 bars after warmup), VPL (only 317 rows)

Read the best slope column downwards. 3 distinct values across 7 rows — one repeated value means the two parameters are separable and nothing here is new; a drift is the interaction this sweep exists to find, and the hypothesis predicts it drifts LOOSER (higher, or None) as PERCENT_SELL falls.
gain is a paired per-symbol median against the cell in the SAME row at the live slope, which holds the price threshold fixed so only the gate moves. The last column is that row's live-slope cell against the grid's live cell, and it is there to stop a row that wins purely on PERCENT_SELL from reading as a gate finding.

Heat map: rows = PERCENT_SELL, columns = SELL_MIN_SIGNAL1

Read the plateau, not the best cell. The best of 77 cells looks good whether or not any edge exists — about 3 of them reach p<0.05 by chance alone. Check Neighbours agreeing before believing any single cell, and check Reinvests to see whether a winning cell actually changed the re-entry behaviour or just moved the sells.

Ma trận ghép cặp — mọi cặp ô

Ô là dòng trừ cột, ghép cặp trên từng mã: xanh nghĩa là dòng hơn cột. Bảng vs ở trên chỉ hiện một mốc mỗi lần; bảng này hiện tất cả, nên nhìn được hình dạng — ô thắng có nối thành vùng liền hay chỉ rải rác.
52 mã · 77 ô · 2926 cặp · 21 cặp có p<0.05, ngẫu nhiên sẽ có khoảng 146 — nên vài ô đậm lẻ tẻ không nói lên gì, chỉ một khối đậm liền nhau mới đáng đọc.
Trung vị và tổng có thể trái dấu: một ngưỡng thắng ở nhiều mã hơn vẫn có thể lỗ tổng, nếu một mã lệch rất lớn. Đổi tab để thấy cả hai. Lưới 77 ô nên không có tooltip: đổi tab để đọc từng chỉ số.
